mapper.select: SELECT L.COMPANY_CODE, L.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, L.PASSWORD AS dbPassword, L.FAIL_COUNT, L.STATUS, L.LOCKED_DATE, L.LAST_LOGIN, U.ROLE_CODE FROM TB_LOGIN_MASTER L JOIN TB_USER_MASTER U ON L.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE L.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LOGIN_MASTER SET FAIL_COUNT = FAIL_COUNT + 1, UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE TB_LOGIN_MASTER SET FAIL_COUNT = #{failCount}, UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
